skills.name: hypercli
skills.description: Operate HyperCLI product APIs, GPU jobs, media flows, voice, and managed agents with the `hyper` CLI. Use as the router for identity, credentials, agents, compute, flows, files, and voice operations.

skills.name: hypercli-account
skills.description: Inspect the active HyperCLI identity, capabilities, and entitlements with hyper me, manage the account profile and Agent soul or role metadata with hyper user and hyper soul, write the local product API key with hyper configure, and check billing balance, API keys, and wallet with hyper billing, hyper keys, and hyper wallet. Use for who-am-I, capability, entitlement, profile, and balance questions; hypercli-auth owns credential precedence and auth failure diagnosis, and grant-code redemption belongs to hypercli-agents.

skills.name: hypercli-agents
skills.description: Create, run, inspect, and control managed HyperCLI agents across the openclaw, hermes, goose, opencode, and buzz runtimes. Use for `hyper agents` lifecycle and wait, logs, exec, shell, file copies, routines, grant activation with `hyper agents activate`, dynamic routes, archive and restore, and OpenClaw-only configuration through the hidden `hyper agents config` and `hyper agents models` commands. Credential precedence and API-base selection are owned by `hypercli-auth`.

skills.name: hypercli-auth
skills.description: Diagnose and configure HyperCLI credentials, API bases, and inactive keys, and authenticate hosted Buzz coding-runtime harnesses. Use when choosing between HYPER_API_KEY and HYPER_AGENTS_API_KEY, running hyper me safely, applying hyper configure, or signing OpenCode, Goose, Claude Code, Codex, or Kimi Code into a hosted runtime. This skill owns credential precedence, API-base selection, and harness sign-in rules.

skills.name: hypercli-compute
skills.description: Browse the live GPU catalog and create, inspect, and control GPU compute with hyper jobs. Use for hyper jobs gpus inventory, job submission preflighted with --dry-run, job list/get/logs, cancellation, and the hidden extend and exec power commands. Named hypercli-compute, not hypercli-jobs, for its former breadth across hyper jobs and the retired hyper instances group. Not for media renders (hypercli-flows) or managed agent runtimes (hypercli-agents).

skills.name: hypercli-flows
skills.description: Generate images and videos with managed media flows (Qwen 2.1 and LTX 2.3 families today). Use for hyper flow catalog and describe discovery, hyper files upload for owned render-input media IDs, exact-input submit-once rendering, and tracking renders with status, wait, get, list, and gated cancel to completed, failed, or cancelled terminal states. Not for durable file storage or shared knowledge workspaces; that is the hypercli-knowledge surface.
commands: hyper flow submit qwen21 image_qwen_image_2_1_t2i --input 'prompt=42' --input seed=0 --json
hyper flow submit ltx23 video_ltx2_3_ia2v --input 'value=a presenter speaking' --media input=OWNED_IMAGE_ID --media audio=OWNED_AUDIO_ID --json

skills.name: hypercli-knowledge
skills.description: Upload and inspect platform files, manage durable HyperCLI shared knowledge workspaces, search/sync/download Markdown projections, control grants, and convert captions or documents into local OpenClaw memory. Use for hyper files, hyper workspaces, and hyper memory commands. When a file exists only as an input to media rendering, use the hypercli-flows skill instead; this skill owns durable knowledge, not render inputs.
commands: hyper workspaces create "Team Knowledge" --slug team-knowledge --output json
hyper workspaces upload team-knowledge ./report.pdf --path projects/acme/report.pdf --output json

skills.name: hypercli-voice
skills.description: Generate speech by cloning a reference voice with hyper voice clone (--file or --url reference audio, saved with --out), transcribe audio with hyper voice transcribe, and preflight the voice capability with hyper me. Use for CLI speech generation, voice cloning, and speech-to-text; preset TTS and VoiceDesign commands are removed. Credential rules are owned by hypercli-auth.
commands: hyper voice clone "Hello world" --file reference.wav --out cloned.mp3
hyper voice clone "Hello world" --url https://example.com/reference.wav --out cloned.mp3
hyper voice transcribe speech.wav --language en --out transcript.txt
